library_backend.description: Backend to use for the library (e.g., m3u, sqlite, file). m3u keeps playlists in M3U format files.

core_max_history_size.description: Maximum number of tracks to retain in the playback history.

local_enabled.description: Enable scanning and playback of local music files.

local_media_dir.description: Directory containing local music files. Must be readable by the mopidy user.

local_scan_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before re-scanning the media directory for changes.

local_scan_flush_threshold.description: Number of files to scan before flushing the library cache (tuning parameter).

local_scan_ignore_patterns.description: List of filename glob patterns to skip during local scan.

local_images_enabled.description: Enable local image search (e.g., album art embedded or in the same folder).

local_images_search_dirs.description: Additional directories to search for images (if not using default media_dir). Leave empty to use media_dir.

file_enabled.description: Enable the file backend to serve local files via the file:// URI scheme.

file_media_dir.description: Base directory for file:// URIs (if different from local media_dir).

file_allowed_extensions.description: File extensions that may be played via the file backend.

http_enabled.description: Enable the HTTP server (provides web API, stream, and optional web UI).

http_hostname.description: Network interface to bind to. Use '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only.

http_port.description: TCP port for the HTTP API/stream.

http_allowed_origins.description: List of allowed CORS origins (e.g., ['https://mydomain.com']). Empty = allow all.

mpd_enabled.description: Enable the MPD server for compatibility with MPD clients (e.g., ncmpcpp, Sonata).

mpd_hostname.description: Network interface to bind MPD to.

mpd_password.description: Password required for MPD clients (empty = no authentication).

webstats_enabled.description: Enable the webstats extension, which logs track events to a JSON file (useful for analytics).

spotify_enabled.description: Enable Spotify playback (requires valid credentials from developer account).

spotify_username.description: Spotify username (not email). Required if Spotify is enabled.

spotify_client_id.description: Spotify app client ID (must be registered at developer.spotify.com).

spotify_client_secret.description: Spotify app client secret (treated as sensitive — never expose in public clients).

spotify_cache_path.description: Optional absolute path to store Spotify auth tokens (e.g., '/var/lib/mopidy/spotify/credentials.cache').

spotify_enabled_oauth.description: Enable automatic token refresh via OAuth (recommended for long-running sessions).

extensions.description: List of additional Mopidy extensions to enable, with custom config. Each item defines the extension name, description, enabled status, and any config key-value pairs.

config.description: Extension-specific config key-value pairs (string keys and values)
